questions.question: Moses said Israel might face horses, chariots and a bigger army in battle. Why should they not be afraid?

answers.text: The LORD their God is with them
Their swords are stronger than chariots
Their enemies will run away first

questions.question: In Moses' laws for war, who was to come forward and speak to the army before battle?
In Moses' laws for war, what must Israel do first when they approach a city to fight against it?
Moses told Israel to completely destroy the nations living in the land God was giving them. Why?

answers.text: So they can't teach Israel what they do for their gods
So Israel can take all of their silver and gold
So they can't attack Israel's cities from behind
